title: Hand-off point
description: Where the physical hand-off happens for this order's exchange. Each bonded order with a physical exchange carries its own hand-off (the merchant→courier pickup, the courier→buyer drop-off, the on-site counter). The proximity-verification policy (figaro-proximity-policy) nests under this hand-off — the bands that certify the exchange.

fields.name: handoff
fields.description: Where the physical exchange happens. face-to-face = in person; dead-drop = left at an agreed spot; parking-area = curbside/lot; locker = a parcel locker. At least one must be set when this clause is included in an agreement.
